name: Transparency Data Report 21
definition: Provides for reporting details of non-equity instruments as part of transparency calculations.

TechnicalRecordIdentification.name: Technical Record Identification
TechnicalRecordIdentification.definition: Unique identifier of a record in a message used as part of error management and status advice messages.||Usage:|This identification will be used in the status advice report sent back.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identifies the financial instrument using an ISIN.

FullName.name: Full Name
FullName.definition: Full name or description of the financial instrument.

TradingVenue.name: Trading Venue
TradingVenue.definition: Segment MIC for the trading venue where applicable, otherwise the operational MIC.

ReportingDate.name: Reporting Date
ReportingDate.definition: Date this information is reported in relation to.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Maturity date of the financial instrument. Field applicable for the asset classes of bonds, interest rate derivatives, equity derivatives, commodity derivatives, foreign exchange derivatives, credit derivatives, C10 derivatives and derivatives on emission allowances.

UnderlyingInstrumentAssetClass.name: Underlying Instrument Asset Class
UnderlyingInstrumentAssetClass.definition: Details on the type of asset class a non-equity financial instrument can be classified as.

DerivativeContractType.name: Derivative Contract Type
DerivativeContractType.definition: Details on the contract type a derivative non-equity financial instrument can be classified as.

Bond.name: Bond
Bond.definition: Details specific to a bond / debt instrument.

EmissionAllowanceType.name: Emission Allowance Type
EmissionAllowanceType.definition: Details the reporting of the emission allowance sub type.

ValidISINRule.definition: ISIN code must pass checksum validation.

ValidMICRule.definition: Where reported, Market Identification code must be an active market for that reporting period.
